name: nyobakantorai
description: Local-first, human-governed multi-agent office with evidence-gated task orchestration.

scripts.test: npm run test:core && npm run test:python && npm run test:demo && npm run test:hermes
scripts.test:core: npm --prefix office run check && node --test packages/task-registry/registry.test.mjs packages/runtime-adapter/index.test.mjs packages/runtime-adapter/http-readonly.test.mjs
scripts.audit: node scripts/repo-audit.mjs && npm run security:scan && npm run public:scan
scripts.verify: npm run doctor && npm run workforce:check && npm run audit && npm test && npm run build && npm run test:smoke
scripts.smoke: npm run build && npm run test:smoke
scripts.release:check: npm run verify && npm run release:manifest
